subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Recap + follow-ups from today — Hosted API pricing

Hi Nora,

Thanks for the call today — really appreciate the time. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can put together a tailored hosted pricing estimate: 

1) Production use case: personalized product recommendations + checkout assistant (real-time chat).
2) Expected steady-state monthly token volume: you mentioned ~200M tokens/month as a baseline and potential to grow. Could you confirm an expected range (low/likely/high) for monthly tokens?
3) Peak throughput: you estimated a peak of ~15 TPS for production spikes and a higher burst during flash sales — can you confirm peak sustained TPS vs short burst TPS?
4) Target unit economics: you said the team wants to stay near $2k–$3k / 1M tokens (overall budget range for the feature). Is that target for inference-only costs or includes other infra?

Attachments: I attached a short pricing sheet and a template for traffic shape if you want to drop in expected hourly TPS over a week — that helps us size reserved capacity vs on-demand.

Next steps: if you can send the range for monthly tokens and clarify sustained vs burst TPS, I’ll put together a 2-option quote (hosted simple plan + reserved burst-capacity recommendation) and route it to finance for the estimated spend.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Recap + follow-ups from today — Hosted API pricing

Hi Sean — thanks for the note and for the helpful template. Confirming numbers from our side after syncing with our eng/product leads: 

- Monthly tokens (low/likely/high): 120M / 260M / 420M tokens
- Sustained peak TPS (what we'd expect for ~95th percentile traffic): 12 TPS sustained for ~10 minutes during promotional events
- Short burst TPS (very short bursts during flash sales): up to 65 TPS for ~30-90 seconds
- Target budget: USD 5k–8k / month for inference for this feature initially (we put the $/1M token target internally at about $2.5k for planning) — that should be inference only, excluding other infra.

We also attached a quick hourly TPS export from our load testing — hope that helps. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to go over traffic shapes.

Cheers,
Nora

Thanks Nora — this is perfect and very helpful. A couple of quick clarifying questions before I model the cost: 

- The monthly token bands you provided: are those per-feature (recommendations + checkout assistant combined) or combined across all features? My understanding from the call is combined for the product feature set we discussed, but want to confirm.
- For the short bursts (65 TPS), do you expect those to be evenly distributed across the hour during sales windows, or concentrated in 30–90 second spikes? This affects whether we recommend reserved burst capacity vs autoscaling on the hosted plan.
- You mentioned $5k–8k/mo budget for inference — does that need to be a hard cap for month 1, or is there flexibility for month 1 to exceed and then stabilize?

If you prefer, we can do a 20-minute call to finalize these and I’ll deliver a two-option quote (Host/On-demand + Host/Reserved-burst) with estimated $/1M token for each band.

If helpful, quoted text from your message: 
> - Monthly tokens (low/likely/high): 120M / 260M / 420M tokens
> - Sustained peak TPS (95th): 12 TPS sustained
> - Short burst TPS: up to 65 TPS for ~30-90 seconds
> - Target budget: USD 5k–8k / month (inference only)

Best,
Sean

Hey Sean — quick answers from infra: 

- The monthly token bands are combined for the two features (recommendations + assistant).
- Bursts are concentrated: the 65 TPS numbers are 30–90s spikes, typically at the start of promotional pushes — not evenly spread over the hour.
- Budget flexibility: month 1 we can tolerate a ~20% overrun if we get clear unit economics and a plan to optimize (caching + batching). After that we'd expect to hit the $5k–8k target.

If it helps, we can share a 72-hour sample from our staging run (anonymized) — say yes and we’ll upload to the traffic template.
